thread:
Noah Patel: hey all, first day! quick map request: if i have (A) account/setup issues, (B) API/SDK questions, (C) product/requirements questions, and (D) just a fun intro post, where do each belong? also can i stop the onboarding bot DMs after day 1?

IT Support: welcome Noah :wave: A -> #help-it (tag @IT Support) for accounts, laptop, VPN. Include OS + short error. B -> #eng for SDK/help or #devx for docs/cli. C -> #product. D -> #random or #introductions (we use #introductions for quick hello threads).

Maya L.: tiny etiquette: always use threads for follow-ups, avoid @channel unless urgent, and use short subject line in the root message for longer threads (e.g., "SDK auth error: 401").

Noah Patel: nice, thanks. example for errors?

Maya L.: paste minimal info in a code block, e.g.:

Maya L.: ```
rwctl login --org=redwood
Error: unauthorized (401)
CLI: rwctl 0.9.1
OS: macOS 14
Steps tried: cleared token, reinstalled CLI
```

Onboarding Bot: Hi Noah! :tada: I've started your Day-1 checklist in DMs. To mute daily tips DM me `unsubscribe` or run `/onboard mute` in any channel. To re-enable, DM `subscribe`.

Product Ops: small note: product questions that affect roadmap or metrics -> add "tag: roadmap" in the message so PMs see it. Non-urgent product asks are fine in #product and we'll triage.

Noah Patel: great. one more: where do i post for pairing or 1:1 scheduling?

Maya L.: DMs are fine for 1:1s, or use the team calendar. For pairing requests that might help others, post in the team channel with your timezone and "no-urgent" if you don't need an immediate reply.

Noah Patel: perfect—appreciate the map and the bot tips. i'll mute tips after i finish day 1. :thumbsup:
